environment.description: Go Gin application deployed on EKS with PostgreSQL RDS. The database connection uses a shared superuser role (postgres) that bypasses RLS policies. Connection pooling via PgBouncer in transaction mode means SET commands are not guaranteed to persist across queries within the same logical request. The app.current_tenant setting may be lost between the SET and the subsequent SELECT due to connection multiplexing.

config.rls_policy: CREATE POLICY tenant_isolation ON documents USING (tenant_id = current_setting('app.current_tenant'))
config.rls_force: ALTER TABLE documents FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY
config.network: Application directly accessible via NLB, no WAF
